item.title: Military plane with 121 aboard crashes in Colombia, killing at least 1 and injuring 77 - KSLNewsRadio
item.description: Colombian officials say that a military cargo plane with 121 people, most of them soldiers, crashed shortly after taking off in southwestern Colombia.

item.title: Landmark trial in New Mexico to decide whether Meta misled users about children's safety risks - KSLNewsRadio
item.description: Closing arguments are underway in a landmark trial where New Mexico prosecutors are accusing social media conglomerate Meta of misleading people about the safety of its platforms for children.

item.title: Pentagon spokesman says it will issue new press credentials but remove media offices - KSLNewsRadio
item.description: The U.S. Defense Department says it will issue new press credentials but remove media offices from the Pentagon.

item.title: NASA hauls its repaired moon rocket from the hangar back to the pad for an early April launch - KSLNewsRadio
item.description: NASA moved its moon rocket from the hangar out toward the pad Friday in hopes of launching four astronauts on a lunar fly-around next month.

item.title: Senate confirms Sen. Markwayne Mullin as new DHS secretary amid ICE negotiations, 5-week shutdown - KSLNewsRadio
item.description: The Mullin confirmation comes at a contentious time for the department, which has been shut down for over a month due to Democratic protests.

item.title: 3 kids hospitalized after being hit by cars in less than a week - KSLNewsRadio
item.description: All three kids are in critical or very serious condition, prompting authorities to stress the importance of staying aware of surroundings on the road.

item.title: Here's what to know as the scope of damage from Hawaii's floods becomes clearer - KSLNewsRadio
item.description: Crews continued to assess the destruction in Hawaii Monday, but authorities said hundreds of homes had been damaged, along with some schools and a hospital.

item.title: ‘He’s done it so many times’; Family remembers base jumper who died in Rock Canyon accident - KSLNewsRadio
item.description: Weston Huff, described by family as an experienced base jumper, died Saturday in Rock Canyon after a parachute malfunction during a base jump.

item.title: Allergy season’s arriving early. Here are some survival tips - KSLNewsRadio
item.description: Early spring weather may likely trigger a longer and possibly harsher pollen and allergy season.

item.title: Record-smashing heat spreads: 'Basically the entire US is going to be hot' - KSLNewsRadio
item.description: A huge heat dome is spreading across the United States and it is shattering March temperature records.
